ChangeNotes.Value:
v3.2.0 - the NPCs can speak on your own claude.ai plan, and every exchange carries a third fewer words.
YOUR OWN CLAUDE PLAN * New backend "ClaudeCode": the NPCs speak through the Claude Code app you already have, on a claude.ai Pro/Max plan - no API key anywhere. Pick which Claude answers in the mod options. * They no longer think silently before speaking on that road, so replies come back sooner and spend less of your plan. * The cost notice shows your plan's own gauge after each exchange - "5h at 9%, weekly at 1%".
LIGHTER, CHEAPER CONVERSATIONS * An exchange costs about a third less - the same knowledge carried in far fewer words. Old battles fold into one line naming the hardest fight, quiet stops on the road no longer take a line each, and long runs of like events gather into one. * New setting, "How long they speak": Brief, Conversational or Full. Shorter is also noticeably faster, since most of the wait is the writing. * Replies no longer grow and grow through an evening - each turn is sized by the moment, not by the last reply. * An NPC weighs her heart once per exchange now, instead of two or three times inside one message. * Memory-writing room grows with the bond: someone you met once writes a short memory, a lifelong companion gets the full page.
SEEING WHAT THEY ARE GIVEN * Scroll up past the oldest word and the next prompt now reads in named, coloured sections - who they are, what you are to them, news of the world, the battles you shared - with the weight of it in tokens at the top.
THE ROAD TO MARRIAGE * Courtship begins on its own now: NPCs set down that they like you, or that they love you, as their heart finds it, instead of treating the first step as a proposal. * And it no longer waits on the calendar. A heart that has come all the way to you can be asked the same evening and say yes. What still refuses is only ever theirs - their regard, their station, their own written misgivings. * A misgiving reworded is no longer written down twice, which used to leave an unanswerable twin quietly blocking the road to marriage.
FIXED * A crash on the day a child was due, when a woman player took a lover without marrying him - the child was begun with no father recorded, and the save crashed again on every load. A save already carrying such a child is repaired at the birth. * Two women, or two men, no longer conceive a child between them. * On the Claude Code backend a reply could arrive wearing its raw machinery; such replies now parse cleanly, and any already recorded in a memory heal themselves.
